purpose: Re-check the runtime inventory against the repository it names: every pinned tooling digest still matches, so every probe in this bundle was read against a runtime and a toolchain this record still describes.
argv:
import hashlib, json, sys
inventory = json.load(open('docs/research/bounded-discovery-qualification-2026-09-12/probes/P00-runtime-inventory/inventory.json'))
drift = []
for path, expected in sorted(inventory['pinned_tooling_sha256'].items()):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(open(path, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    if digest != expected:
        drift.append(path)
print('runtime', inventory['runtime']['cli'], inventory['runtime']['version'])
print('pinned tooling files:', len(inventory['pinned_tooling_sha256']))
print('drifted:', drift or 'none')
sys.exit(1 if drift else 0)
